decisions.reason: As a technically capable, R&D-active specialist with a narrow portfolio, the firm is likely to keep this adjacent but somewhat riskier wafer innovation on the market because there is no clear evidence of performance below aspiration and it fits its move toward more complex packaging substrates.

This carrier wafer is very close to the firm's established handling and substrate business, matches its stated strategic direction toward reusable carriers, and would likely be retained while management waits for market feedback unless results clearly fall short of aspiration.
